data.description:
## Context

DSO plugin maintainers running /dso:brainstorm → /dso:preplanning → /dso:sprint on cross-skill epics face a structural reliability gap: when stories communicate via non-structured signals (bare tag strings, title prefixes, status tokens, file-path conventions), the integration between producer and consumer is not enforced at any gate. Epic f360-3a5b shipped with producer-side `copy-story` and consumer-side `copy:needed` plus a missing implementation-plan bypass, and the completion-verifier's P1=PASS verdict was a structural false positive. This epic (Epic A of two) delivers the foundation and the producer/consumer signaling-core enforcement; Epic B (separately brainstormed) layers verifier consumer-side execution and brainstorm dispatch-path dogfood on top.

EPIC_CLASS: class:architectural

## Success Criteria

1. The `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/` directory convention exists with the schema {canonical_name, canonical_surface, semantic, producer, consumers, smoke_test}. The reference contract doc at `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-story.md` passes a schema validator; its sibling `plugins/dso/tests/contract-copy-story.sh` runs green via test-batched.sh. Every file under `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/*.md` validates against the schema via a pre-commit/CI hook that fails the build on any non-conforming doc.
2. dso:story-decomposer adopts Design C hybrid: per-story inline `emits_signals` / `consumes_signals` fields with `{canonical_name, surface, semantic}` (plus `detection` on consumer); post-draft `signal_manifest` reflection block; deterministic critic script. The critic enforces three checks — (a) each declared `producer_surface` appears in the named producer story body and each `consumer_detection` appears in the named consumer story body; (b) for every `canonical_name` with a corresponding `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<canonical_name>.md`, the producer-side `surface` and the consumer-side `detection` BOTH match the contract doc's `canonical_surface` field (anti-typo-coherence anchor); (c) cross-story edges are derived by matching `consumes_signals.canonical_name` against `emits_signals.canonical_name`. On the f360-3a5b pre-fix fixture, the decomposer output contains a critic-error and refuses to emit until the surfaces are reconciled.
3. /dso:preplanning's fan-in detector computed against the union of the `depends_on` graph and the `cross_story_signals` graph requires an integration story when either (a) any node has fan-in ≥ 2 in either graph, OR (b) any cross_story_signals edge exists at all (every cross-story signal coupling — including 1:1, the f360 shape — warrants integration coverage). The integration story's Done Definition references an orchestrator-entry fixture exercising producer → consumer → artifact through /dso:brainstorm or /dso:preplanning.
4. The decomposer's critic includes a heuristic post-pass that scans each producer story's file_impact and body for tag-emit patterns (e.g., `--tags <bare-string>`, `ticket tag <id> <bare-string>`), title-prefix patterns (quoted literal title patterns in story bodies), and file-path-convention patterns (paths under tickets-tracker, plugins/dso/docs/contracts/, etc.). When any pattern is detected on a story whose `emits_signals` is empty, the critic flags the story as `undeclared-signal` and refuses to emit until the author either adds the signal declaration OR adds an explicit `signals_disclaimer: <one-sentence rationale>` field justifying the omission.
5. A regression fixture family at `plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/cross-skill-integration/` contains exactly three variants — (a) `tag-fork/` (producer emits `copy-story`, consumer detects `copy:needed` — the f360-3a5b shape); (b) `surface-typo-coherence/` (producer emits `copy-stroy`, consumer detects `copy-stroy` — matching wrong surface, no contract doc); (c) `zero-declaration/` (producer story touches tag-emit patterns but declares zero signals). Each variant fed through /dso:brainstorm → /dso:preplanning independently triggers ≥ 1 distinct enforcement gate (drift critic, canonical anchor, heuristic post-pass). A dedicated regression test asserts each fixture-gate pairing.

## State Lifecycle

| Variable | CREATE | UPDATE | CONSUME | RETIRE |
|----------|--------|--------|---------|--------|
| plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<name>.md | constants-doc story authored under Gap A (via /dso:preplanning) | future stories that change canonical_surface | story-decomposer critic; future Epic B completion-verifier; human readers | never retired — persists as canonical contract record |
| plugins/dso/tests/contract-<name>.sh | constants-doc story Done Definition (per epic delivering a new signal) | story author when canonical_surface changes | future Epic B completion-verifier; test-batched.sh | never retired |
| plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/cross-skill-integration/ | this epic's regression-fixture story | future epic post-mortems extend the family with new variants | regression test runs in CI | never retired — fixture family grows over time |
| cross_story_signals manifest in story-decomposer output | story-decomposer Design C reflection step | story-decomposer on re-decomposition | story-decomposer critic; /dso:preplanning fan-in gate | per-epic ephemeral — constants doc is the durable record |
| per-story emits_signals / consumes_signals fields | story-decomposer inline at draft time | story-decomposer on re-decomposition | story-decomposer critic; /dso:preplanning fan-in gate; future Epic B verifier | per-story ephemeral — discarded when story closes |

## Scope (out)

- Gap C (completion-verifier consumer_smoke_tests population) — moved to follow-on Epic B.
- Gap D (brainstorm Phase 1.5 dispatch-path detector + dogfood SC template) — moved to follow-on Epic B.
- Structured (JSON-schema-validated) cross-skill payloads — already enforced.
- Retroactive backfill of constants docs / smoke tests for already-closed epics.
- /dso:sprint Phase E and /dso:implementation-plan changes beyond reading the new signal_manifest field.

## Dependencies

None.
data.title: Cross-skill signal contracts foundation + decomposer enforcement + preplanning fan-in gate
